summary.en: Real lines of a real file set as they are: one mono, one colour, real line numbers in a gutter, the path as the label; one accent underline under a token, or a diff’s muted minus line and accent-barred plus line.
summary.zh: 照原样排出的真实文件行：一种等宽字体、一种颜色、行号放在侧栏、路径作标签；一道强调色下划线标出一个词，或一组 diff 的减行（灰）和带强调竖条的加行。

fits: Quoting the input a result was made from.
notFor: Code written for the film; syntax-highlighted code; more than six lines.

intent.en: Quote the input exactly, with its line numbers, so it can be checked.
intent.zh: 原样引用输入并带行号，让人能去核对。

content.en: 2–6 lines (≤ 64 characters) with the first line’s number and the file’s path; a token to underline or a line before and after.
content.zh: 2–6 行（≤ 64 字符），带首行行号和文件路径；要下划线的词，或改前改后的一行。

fits.zh: 引用产生某个结果的输入。

notFor.zh: 为片子现写的代码；带语法高亮的代码；多于六行。

en: No syntax colours: the accent is the only colour.
zh: 不加语法颜色：强调色是唯一的颜色。

fits: any film whose input maps line by line to an output

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
